$comment: ADR-324 world-scale travel for AI humans (ai/travel.ts). Ticks at 20 Hz, distances in tiles. Routes: A* over a coarse region grid (regionTiles cells, water-sampled cost), then local nav (goTo / creature_nav) between region centres, so no path length cap. roam = per-AI preference from traits (roamWeights) vs roamTraitMin; clan members below it (or under a BuildBase / Defend clan order) stay within clanStayRadius of the clan anchor, roamers go and come back after roamReturnTicks; unattached AIs roam freely; hired workers only travel when sent. offscreen: bots farther than fullSimTiles from every human while travelling step coarsely along their route (no controller, not a chunk source) and hand back to full sim near a human or on arrival.
